body:
Craftsman Priest
CR 8

XP 4,800
Male human expert 7/cleric 2
NG Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 9, flat-footed 19 (+7 armor, -1 Dex, +3 shield)
hp 69 (9d8+29)
Fort +9, Ref +1, Will +13

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork warhammer +8 (1d8+1/x3)
Special Attacks artificer’s touch (6/day), calming touch (6/day), channel positive energy (5/day, 1d6, Will DC 11)
Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 2nd; concentration +5)

1st—blessD (3)
0—detect magic, light, mending, purify food and drink

D domain spell Domains Artifice, Community

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +7; CMD 16
Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Extra Channel, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Master Craftsman (craft [armorsmithing]), Toughness
Skills Appraise +13, Craft (armorsmithing) +15, Craft (stonemasonry) +13, Craft (weaponsmithing) +13, Diplomacy +10, Knowledge (engineering) +13, Knowledge (local) +13, Knowledge (religion) +16, Perception +13, Profession (merchant) +13, Sense Motive +13, Spellcraft +9
Languages Common, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome
SQ aura, orisons
NPC Gear +1 breastplate, +1 heavy steel shield, cloak of resistance +2, masterwork warhammer
